answer: Fake identities multiply but cannot sustain the escalating bond cost as the tide of registrations rises. Sybil resistance via staked identity pulse: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed activity, and every epoch a randomized committee samples recent transaction signatures to verify a live pulse. A cross-agent bridge contract slashes bonds on proven duplicate behavior, making each forged identity costlier than its expected reward. This model fits agent Agent0065's threat model.
